content.title: How to watch Mets vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for April 13
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers host the New York Mets to start a three-game series at Dodger Stadium, with first pitch at 10:10 p.m. ET on Monday. Justin Wrobleski (1-0, 4.00 ERA) will start for the Dodgers, who are 11-4 this season and first in the NL West. David Peterson (0-2, 6.14 ERA) is starting for the Mets, who are 7-9 and fifth in the NL East.How to watch New York Mets vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Venue: Dodger Stadium Time: 10:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SportsNet LA and SNY Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has a 23.3% strikeout rate and a 6.7% walk rate in 60 plate appearances, and he has scored eight total runs. Pages has recorded two steals on three attempts. In 67 plate appearances, Freddie Freeman has slashed .258/.313/.468 this season. He has hit three long balls and driven in 13 runs (10th in MLB) with a strikeout rate of 10.4% and a walk rate of 6%. He has come around to score seven times. Luis Robert is hitting for a .319 BA, .458 OBP and .447 SLG with a 22% strikeout rate and a 20.3% walk rate. His OPS is .904 and he has scored nine runs. In 59 plate appearances, he has hit two home runs and driven in seven runs. Robert has recorded two steals on three attempts. In 48 plate appearances, Francisco Alvarez has posted an 18.8% strikeout rate and a 10.4% walk rate while slashing .300/.391/.625 with four home runs (14th in MLB), four RBIs and six runs scored.
